import sys

# Read all lines, strip whitespace, convert to int, sort
with open('/workspace/input/numbers.txt', 'r') as f:
    numbers = [int(line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()]

numbers.sort()

# Write sorted numbers, one per line
with open('/workspace/output/sorted_numbers_asc.txt', 'w') as f:
    for n in numbers:
        f.write(str(n) + '\n')

# Optional: print summary (not required in output file)
print(f'Total count: {len(numbers)}')
print(f'Min: {numbers[0]}, Max: {numbers[-1]}')
print(f'First 10: {numbers[:10]}')
print(f'Last 10: {numbers[-10:]}')

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.description: Publish an existing output file under /workspace/output for the user to download or preview. Call after checking its content. Optionally request an independent integer-sort or multiples filter validation when applicable.

path.description: Existing sandbox file path, e.g. /workspace/output/result.csv

validation.description: Default file: verify readability and hash. Use a numeric validator only for the corresponding task.

import csv

# 读取input/sales.csv文件

import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 读取category_totals.json文件
with open('/workspace/output/category_totals.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# 提取类别和对应的销售额
categories = list(data.keys())
amounts = list(data.values())

# 创建柱状图
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.bar(categories, amounts)

# 设置标题和坐标轴标签（使用英文）
plt.title('Category Sales Totals')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Total Amount')

# 在每个柱子上显示数值
for i, v in enumerate(amounts):
    plt.text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom')

# 保存图表到output/category_chart.png
plt.savefig('/workspace/output/category_chart.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"图表已生成: {categories} -> {amounts}")

args.content:
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 读取category_totals.json文件
with open('/workspace/output/category_totals.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# 提取类别和对应的销售额
categories = list(data.keys())
amounts = list(data.values())

# 创建柱状图
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.bar(categories, amounts)

# 设置标题和坐标轴标签（使用英文）
plt.title('Category Sales Totals')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Total Amount')

# 在每个柱子上显示数值
for i, v in enumerate(amounts):
    plt.text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom')

# 保存图表到output/category_chart.png
plt.savefig('/workspace/output/category_chart.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"图表已生成: {categories} -> {amounts}")

# 保存图表到output/category_chart.png
